scope: Common retained-result admission plus actual Apple R1/R2 Qwen MTP multi-session journeys. No native CLI cache-byte completion, Vulkan backing rotation or full quality acceptance.
implementation: GraphOutput::storage_lease(retention_budget) explicitly admits only the completed retained result. The original no-budget projection has unchanged ownership semantics.
A retained charge stays on the original LeaseDomain; native uses and prior aliases keep it. No new payload copy, result domain, executor, Provider vtable or MLX deleter modification.

Scope-owned live-record list is non-owning. Tokens retain one actual reservation; last token unlinks under lookup lock, then destroys quota/metadata outside that lock. No strong ownership cycle or global cache.

Keys include exact nominated resource and identity authority/value. Cross-domain canonical host addresses are used only when the actual resource explicitly promises HostAddressIdentity; opaque native handles are never guessed to be canonical.

Already-charged exact-resource pool reservation moves into the shared fact without a temporary second payload charge. Failure leaves prior reservation/lease intact. Whole backing is charged, not one logical subview.
Graph retains its existing source-family/resource validation. Different scopes/resources do not bypass each other. Metadata is charged to its actual allocator scope.
